intent: A calm preference form with explicit required updates, generous checkbox rows and an awaited save action that keeps failures visible for retry.

layout.direction: Keep the calm, single-column communication form: a small bell, 30px Instrument Serif heading, 14px option labels and descriptive copy, generous ruled checkbox rows and an aligned save/status row. Use 12px Always on metadata. Keep all surfaces neutral, and set the shared checkbox line token to #737373 so unchecked controls exceed 3:1 contrast in both themes. Keep the existing reserved feedback/button sizing so pending, failure and success do not move the save action.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

motion.entrance: The form enters with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Use the embedded checkbox control kit for checkmark, hover, press and focus behavior. Keep pending fields locked without remounting or changing footer geometry.
motion.reduced: Listen to live preference changes and stop and settle the form entry immediately. The control kit removes its scaling and checkmark travel under reduced motion.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings. Pending Save retains focus with aria-busy/aria-disabled and a synchronous duplicate-request guard; only a missing handler natively disables it. Rejection retains the same focused retry target.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: options
props.description: Choices with stable unique IDs, labels and descriptions. Required options stay selected. Only currently available IDs appear in change/save snapshots.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected IDs. Choices are read-only without onChange. Unknown or duplicate selected IDs are normalized to the available choices.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial local selected IDs, normalized to the available choices with required choices included.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Synchronous notification with an independent selected-ID array. The host owns controlled-state acknowledgement.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Awaited persistence callback with an independent snapshot of available selected and required IDs. Writes stay serial. The action is disabled without a callback or choices; late replies cannot claim a replacement selection was saved.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Keep PreferenceOption and PreferenceCenterProps. Options use stable unique IDs; required choices always stay selected. Normalize selected IDs to the available choices and deduplicate them.
Use local defaultValue state or value with onChange. Controlled choices without a writer are disabled. onChange receives an independent array synchronously and cannot mutate the local draft.

onSave receives a copied snapshot and remains awaited. Permit one write at a time; guard immediately with a ref so checkbox events and duplicate submissions cannot edit or resubmit the in-flight draft.

Keep rejected drafts checked and show the supplied retryable failure copy. Retrying sends the same actual selection. Preserve native checkbox keyboard behavior, visible focus and the focused save action.

Choice-ID, required-state or selected-set replacement retires old feedback. Keep the existing write pending until it finishes, then permit the next write. A late completion cannot mark replacement preferences as saved. Reordering equivalent options or receiving the same selected set keeps the acknowledgement valid.

Disable save without onSave or without available choices. Keep written empty states, independent instances, long copy, required labels and a polite status region. Do not invent a cancellation or concurrent-persistence contract.
